theme_strategy.style: Luxury Restaurant, Cinematic, Editorial Restraint, High-end E-commerce

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold font-serif
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-serif
hierarchy.eyebrow: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-[#D4AF37]

typography.instructions: Import Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' in index.css. Apply font-serif to all headings and font-sans to body. Never use Inter for headings.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px borders tinted with primary color (Gold in dark mode, Dark Green in light mode) to separate surfaces. Avoid flat muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl for luxury cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Dark mode: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#09281E]. Light mode: bg-[#09281E] text-[#D4AF37]. Include scale-105 on hover and subtle ambient glow.
buttons.secondary: Outline style. border-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] (or dark green in light mode) rounded-full. Hover fills background.

cards.menu_card: Vertical layout. Top half: High-res image (max-h-64 object-cover). Bottom half: Glassmorphic surface, elegant typography, price tag prominently displayed, quantity selector, 'Add to Cart' button. Hover effect: slight lift (-translate-y-2).
cards.feature_card: Minimalist bento grid item. Subtle borders, glowing gold accents on hover.

header.style: Sticky z-50. Use Crystal Glassmorphism. Must have brand logo, navigation links, theme toggle, and cart button with badge.

cart_drawer.style: Fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-full max-w-md. Glassmorphic backdrop. Include 'FREE Delivery' badge in gold. Sticky checkout button at the bottom.

grids_layouts.hero: min-h-screen, grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 items-center. Left: Typography and CTAs. Right: Massive Cinematic Food Photography.
grids_layouts.features: Bento Grid Protocol. md:grid-cols-3 or md:grid-cols-4. Asymmetrical spanning to create visual interest. Gaps: gap-6 or gap-8.
grids_layouts.menu: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 max-w-5xl mx-auto gap-8 or gap-12.

effects.hero_text: Staggered fade-up and slight y-translation for h1 and subtitle.
effects.scroll: Use Framer Motion 'whileInView' for cards to elegantly fade up as user scrolls.
effects.cart: Slide in from right (x: '100%' to x: 0). Background overlay fades in (opacity: 0 to 1).
effects.micro_interactions: Button hovers, card lifts, quantity selector scaling on click.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast by using text shadows or gradient overlays.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus-visible rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]).
accessibility.test_ids: MUST include data-testid attributes on buttons, inputs, cart toggle, and checkout elements.

media.strategy: Sensory-First Visual Hunger. High-res imagery. Use object-cover. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

hero_image.description: Chicken curry with yellow rice in a copper bowl. Perfect for the hero section right side or as a full background with heavy overlay.

menu_item_1.description: Beautifully plated Flavoured Rice with Chicken Curry. Use for Menu Card 1.

menu_item_2.description: Chapati/Roti with Chicken Curry. Use for Menu Card 2.

texture_bg.description: Spices on dark background. Use with low opacity (e.g., 10%) as a texture overlay for sections like Features or Footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a premium, cinematic web experience for TANYY CLOUD KITCHEN using React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Enforce the Dark Green + Cream + Gold palette. Dark mode should feel like a high-end luxury restaurant. Use the specified hex codes.
Build the two-item menu layout using large, high-quality luxury cards.
Develop a full checkout flow within a Cart Drawer or separate Checkout Page that captures all user details and opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message upon success.
Implement a hidden Admin panel (e.g., /admin route) interacting with Firebase v12 Firestore to track orders, revenue, and allow CSV export.
Use Lucide-React for all icons (shopping bag, check circle, phone, map pin).
Ensure the PWA is installable with a manifest.json and offline support.
Add Dark/Light mode toggle that correctly switches the Tailwind classes and updates CSS variables.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use high contrast, asymmetrical layouts, and generous padding (p-8 to p-16).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
NEVER center align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. No static elements.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for robust testing.
